comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Aide Quarters Production - Casting -- requires 14th Century Adept of Ages title equipped, plus player's Casting skill at R14 to access (equipping skill boosts is okay) and a reserve Aide whose Casting is also R14 (if they have Casting skill, that gives them +5 boost)

Recipe Materials per armor production:
Steel x40
Fur x10
Suede x20

The armor gives +1 Evasion, and requires 4200 total fame to equip.

Images/source: eririndol.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-229.html
